activities.title: Python Variable Anatomy
activities.instruction: Click each part of the assignment to identify its role.

content.concept: A Python variable associates a name with a value, while the value has a specific data type.

descriptions: The identifier used to access the stored value.
The assignment operator that associates the value with the variable.
The actual data assigned to the variable.
The type of data represented by the value.
